last_scene.summary: Arlequino left the courier yard and searched the lodging district for Gareth and Vern by walking from post-yard to post-yard and performing songs from the previous day. He rotated yesterday's set rather than asking every passerby. Reactions remained mixed and local: the Carrion line in 'Герои' drew strong cheers from some beastfolk fighters; 'Головы с плеч' energized younger mercenaries but made some travelers uncomfortable; 'Авантюрист' lightened the mood and the Blumund reference amused travelers familiar with the place; some people ignored him or kept eating and working. He performed at four small stops and received tips of 1s72c, 2s31c, 1s96c and 2s48c, total 8s47c, with no expenses. Personal cash rose from 20g86s16c to 20g94s63c. At the fourth post-yard, the music finally reached Gareth and Vern, who were there off-contract. They recognized Arlequino and came into view. Stop before Arlequino's next meaningful action or dialogue.
